title: pass_priority until=end_of_turn can time out in golden replay
description: GitHub Actions run `23226427640` failed in `tests/test_golden_end_of_turn_yield.py::test_end_of_turn_yield` after the dataclass migration fix had already cleared the earlier `bolt_on_stack` failure. The replay reaches the scripted `pass_priority(until=\"end_of_turn\")` call, then the bridge blocks for the full tool timeout and returns `MCP tool pass_priority failed: timed out`. This happens in the live Java bridge path during replay, before any export serialization or dataclass-backed golden comparison runs, so it appears to be a separate bridge/golden flake rather than another JSON-boundary bug. The failure should be investigated in the `BridgeCallbackHandler.passPriority(..., until=\"end_of_turn\")` path and related replay/keepAlive ordering, not papered over by changing the golden script.
